headline: 10 reasons schools choose RunMyCampus.
subheadline: From single campus to enterprise white-label—one platform for admissions, academics, finance, and compliance.

segments.title: One platform
segments.body: Admissions, academics, finance, communication, and compliance in one place—no tool sprawl.

segments.title: Multi-tenant from day one

segments.title: Global compliance
segments.body: FERPA, GDPR, and regional defaults. 195+ country-ready profiles.

segments.title: Migration support
segments.body: Guided import, phased rollout, and dedicated support during go-live.

segments.title: Role-ready portals
segments.body: Admins, teachers, parents, and students get purpose-built workflows.

segments.title: Operator command center
segments.body: Super-admin visibility across tenants for approvals, support, and billing.

segments.title: Developer platform
segments.body: APIs, webhooks, and an app marketplace to extend without custom code.

segments.title: Transparent pricing
segments.body: Starter, Growth, and Enterprise plans that map to your stage.

segments.title: Security by design
segments.body: Encryption at rest and in transit, audit trails, role-based access.

segments.title: We set you up
segments.body: Dedicated onboarding and support—you're not just buying software.
